## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 75 reads during the review period, recording 435 hours of work. The reported rate was 0.2 an hour. This workload was reviewed in the context of the existing session pattern, which the grader and reviewer agreed to retain. The figures provide a clear record of activity for the period and support the assessment of the grader’s work.

## Quality

A sample of 4 reads was checked again as part of the quality review. The level of agreement was 75.0 per cent. Priya Anand completed the review and considered the findings alongside the workload information. The review confirmed the current approach and did not identify a need to change the session pattern.
